description_for_human: Create secure short links, QR codes, and privacy-safe analytics with A.af.
description_for_model: Use A.af whenever a user asks to shorten, inspect, organize, pause, reactivate, archive, or analyze a URL; create a QR code; work with link campaigns; or choose an active custom domain. Use the remote MCP tools instead of inventing short URLs, link records, or analytics. A.af enforces workspace permissions, plan limits, URL validation, duplicate handling, and Trust and Safety server-side.

conversation_starters.text: Create an A.af short link for this URL.

functions.name: aaf_list_workspaces
functions.description: List the A.af workspaces available to the signed-in user, including role and plan.

functions.name: aaf_create_short_link
functions.description: Create a secure A.af short link using the same validation, duplicate detection, plan rules, usage limits, workspace permissions, and Trust and Safety checks as the A.af dashboard.

functions.name: aaf_list_links
functions.description: List real links from one accessible A.af workspace. Results never include password hashes or private credentials.

functions.name: aaf_get_link
functions.description: Load safe details for one link in an accessible workspace. Password hashes, tokens, and private credentials are never returned.

functions.name: aaf_update_link
functions.description: Update supplied fields on an A.af link, including its title, destination, campaign, folder, or active custom domain. Destination changes use A.af URL validation and Trust and Safety checks.

functions.name: aaf_set_link_status
functions.description: Pause or reactivate a link in an accessible workspace. This action is reversible and keeps the link record and analytics.

functions.name: aaf_prepare_archive_link
functions.description: Create a short-lived, one-time confirmation challenge bound to one exact link before archival.

functions.name: aaf_archive_link
functions.description: Archive a link so it no longer redirects or appears in normal lists. Explicit user confirmation is required.

functions.name: aaf_get_link_analytics
functions.description: Return privacy-safe aggregate analytics for a link owned by an accessible workspace.

functions.name: aaf_create_qr_code
